scenes.lines: trip on my own words— / falling out of life / & find / where you go when you / leave. / It was the maze / constructed / by a tainted love / a known, yet unknown / pit—beneath the / quicksands of the make-believe / haven— / & hidden in the / overnourished forests / of escapism / that calls for you— / at this age / I'll follow, falling / the full distance / between / us almost having / it all / & starting anew— / to rediscover / when love was real. / I've failed at / protecting you / from your own vices—
scenes.treatment: EX falls off fire escape, into darkness, POET fall's behind, into the clouds until it gets as dark as black. BLACK [Title Card] WHERE YOU GO WHEN YOU LEAVE / PART 2 OF 3 / FUTURE. POET falling behind EX (EX's face never shown). Falling surrounded by images of the world chaos swapping with images of ways people escape—drug use, partying, television, media, phone use.
